verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence is a release note saying a model can be imported into OCI Generative AI in the UAE Central (Abu Dhabi) region, which implies region-specific deployment. A community comment adds that Oracle will build configurations in any region globally for large spenders. Neither documents user-selectable storage regions or data-residency guarantees. Missing for 10: first-party docs on region selection when creating storage or resources, data-residency commitments or a region list, and hands-on corroboration that data stays in the chosen region.
